name: 【底辺チューバーからの脱却】名 を たくさん 伝えれる 画期的ツール
description: A rhythm game where you say 'な' (na) to a fixed chart synced to a 175 BPM song. Subscribers inflate YouTube-style toward a quota; stay quiet during flame-up sections or get banned; keep viewers from leaving. Includes timing calibration, 10 special-item effects, YouTube-style milestone cut-ins with a 3D character, rule-based endings and achievements. Microphone detects sound only (no AI).
